name: Scarity: The story of Dread
source:
He doesn’t recognize the number, but the first words make his blood run cold: "Are your parents home?"

Miklos has to tread carefully – one misstep could be fatal.

[From [url=https://halkind.itch.io/scarity]Itch.io[/url]]
